skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand practical knowledge about the adjustment of economic foreign policy models and content of key economic partners of Vietnam, including China, Japan, South Korea, EU, and the US.
Analyze and evaluate the suitability and impact of economic foreign policies on the national economy, localities, and businesses.
Collect and analyze data on economic foreign activities and policies of a country.
Work independently and in groups to solve requirements in studies and tasks.
Self-study and find materials to complete tasks, have a clear understanding of the functions and responsibilities of individuals and groups, and be proactive in solving assigned tasks.
Have a sense of organizational discipline, follow classroom rules, and have a cooperative spirit and responsibility for assigned activities.
